facts.text: The hotel stands beside Piazza Duca d'Aosta and Milano Centrale station.
facts.excerpt: Excelsior Hotel Gallia stands beside Piazza Duca d’Aosta and Milano Centrale station

facts.text: Lake Como, Venice and Florence are a train journey away from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: From the hotel, iconic destinations such as Lake Como, Venice, and Florence are just a convenient train journey away

facts.text: The hotel opened in 1932 as an Art Deco building and is now joined by a steel-and-glass tower designed by Marco Piva.
facts.excerpt: Opened in 1932, the Art Deco landmark is now joined by a Marco Piva-designed steel-and-glass tower

facts.text: The hotel was founded by Carlo Gallia, who spent 15 years working in hotels across Europe before founding it.
facts.excerpt: He remained abroad for the next 15 years, working in several different European locales (London, Paris, Berlin, Lucerne, Monte Carlo, and St. Moritz). Upon returning to Milan with a wealth of experience, he founded our beloved property.

facts.text: The hotel has a collection of more than 500 art pieces, including paintings, sculptures and photographs, designed by Studio Marco Piva exclusively for the property.
facts.excerpt: Discover our unique collection of more than 500 art pieces designed by Studio Marco Piva exclusively for the property, too. These include paintings, sculptures and photographs.

facts.text: All of the hotel's furniture is made in Italy, with several pieces produced with Milanese artisans and designers.
facts.excerpt: All of Excelsior Hotel Gallia’s furniture is Made in Italy, with several pieces produced in collaboration with Milanese artisans and designers.

facts.text: Rooms feature handcrafted and modern elements by local ateliers including B&B Italia, Cassina, Fendi Casa and Flos.
facts.excerpt: boasting a seamless blend of handcrafted and modern elements meticulously curated by local ateliers such as B&B Italia, Cassina, Fendi Casa and Flos

facts.text: Bathrooms showcase Botticino or Emperador marble with Belle Epoque bronze accents.
facts.excerpt: Bathrooms showcase Botticino or Emperador marble set against Belle Époque bronze accents.

facts.text: Atelier Suites are conceived as art galleries, with unique lighting and colour use.
facts.excerpt: our Atelier Suites are conceived as art galleries, upping the theatricality ante with unique lighting and colour use

facts.text: Signature Suites take inspiration from Italian creators such as Gio Ponti and Castiglioni, and many feature their designs.
facts.excerpt: our Signature Suites are infused with inspiration from world renowned Italian creators such as Gio Ponti and Castiglioni–many feature their designs

facts.text: The Katara Royal Suite is a four-bedroom suite on the seventh floor with two terraces, one with a private solarium housing a pagoda spa with a whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: This unique four-bedroom suite, located on the seventh floor, redefines Milanese grandeur. Elevating the experience are two expansive terraces

facts.text: The Katara Royal Suite has a terrace with a private solarium housing a pagoda spa with a whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: the other offering a private solarium housing a pagoda spa, equipped with a whirlpool and a chromotherapy enhanced steam shower

facts.text: Panoramic Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of landmarks and the cityscape.
facts.excerpt: these suites present breathtaking views of landmarks and the cityscape through expansive floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: Many rooms have direct views over Piazza Duca d'Aosta.
facts.excerpt: Many of our family hotel's rooms hold direct views over the Piazza Duca d'Aosta.

facts.text: The Gallia Health Club and Shiseido Spa Milan spans two floors, the sixth and seventh, with panoramic views of the historic city center.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on the sixth and seventh floors of the Excelsior Hotel Gallia, the 1,000-square-meter Gallia Health Club & Shiseido Spa Milan combines the prestige of the premier Shiseido brand with panoramic views of the historic city center.

facts.text: The wellness center has a Himalayan salt cabin, hydrotherapy sessions, wet and dry saunas and a steam room.
facts.excerpt: amenities such as a Himalayan salt cabin, hydrotherapy sessions, wet and dry saunas and a steam room

facts.text: Therapists at the Shiseido Spa specialize in Japanese wellness rituals.
facts.excerpt: Nestled within the Center is the exclusive Shiseido Spa, where expert therapists specialize in centuries-old Japanese wellness rituals.

facts.text: The Private Spa Suite has a treatment room for two, a jacuzzi, sauna, steam room, ice room and relaxation area.
facts.excerpt: the Private Spa Suite features a treatment room for two, jacuzzi, sauna, steam room, ice room, and a serene relaxation area

facts.text: The indoor pool is on the seventh floor and has panoramic views.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the seventh floor of the Excelsior Hotel Gallia, the exclusive indoor pool invites guests to slow down and savor a serene interlude; an oasis of calm where refined ambiance and panoramic views

facts.text: The fitness center on the seventh floor has Technogym machines and city views.
facts.excerpt: Located on the seventh floor of the Excelsior Hotel Gallia, the fitness area is equipped with the most modern machines by Technogym.

facts.text: Dining is led by Chef Vincenzo Lebano in collaboration with the three-Michelin-starred Cerea family.
facts.excerpt: Led by Chef Vincenzo Lebano in collaboration with the...See More three-Michelin-starred Cerea family

facts.text: Terrazza Gallia Bar is a rooftop bar on the seventh floor serving Milanese aperitivo with panoramic views over Piazza Duca d'Aosta.
facts.excerpt: Admire the panoramic view over the capital of fashion from the 7th floor of Excelsior Hotel Gallia; you will marvel at the landscape of Piazza Duca D’Aosta

facts.text: The wine cellar holds over 700 labels, and sommeliers lead personalized wine tastings.
facts.excerpt: The Excelsior Hotel Gallia boasts a wine cellar comprising over 700 labels from the finest vintages worldwide.

facts.text: The hotel offers cooking classes with its chef and cocktail masterclasses with its barmen.
facts.excerpt: Enhance your culinary expertise under the guidance of our talented chef as you choose between mastering timeless Italian classics or exploring the hotel’s signature creations.

facts.text: The head concierge is a member of Les Clefs d'Or.
facts.excerpt: Meet our head concierge, proud member of 'Les Clefs d'Or'.

facts.text: Piazza Gae Aulenti and the Porta Nuova district are within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: Piazza Gae Aulenti and the modern district of Porta Nuova are located at walking distance

facts.text: The Cigar Lounge recreates the classic smoking rooms of Milan's grand railway stations.
facts.excerpt: Since its opening, Excelsior Hotel Gallia has nurtured a tradition of recreating the classic smoking rooms found in Milan’s grand railway stations.

facts.text: Small pets are welcome, one per room.
facts.excerpt: One pet is allowed per room, with a maximum weight of 39.0 lbs.

facts.text: The Katara Royal Suite is described as the largest suite in any Italian hotel.
facts.excerpt: Our luxury hotel's Katara Royal Suite is the largest in any Italian hotel, at 1000 square meters.

facts.text: Brera, the Duomo, Sforzesco Castle and La Scala are described as within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: Most renowned cultural attractions at walking distance: Brera, Duomo, Sforzesco Castle, La Scala

contradictions.note: p1 says the Katara Royal Suite is the largest in any Italian hotel; p3 says it is one of the largest in Europe

sources.excerpt: Our luxury hotel's Katara Royal Suite is the largest in any Italian hotel, at 1000 square meters.
Our crowning jewel, the Katara Royal Suite, reigns as one of the largest in Europe, spanning an impressive 1000 square meters.
